:::{#sol-homogeneous-absolute-value}

No.
Take $c = -1$ and $x = 1$.
Then

$$
f(c x) = \abs{-1} = 1,
\qquad
c f(x) = -1 \cd \abs{1} = -1.
$$

These differ,
so $f$ is not [homogeneous](#def-homogeneous-function).
It does satisfy $f(c x) = c f(x)$ for every $c \ge 0$,
since then $\abs{c x} = c \abs{x}$.

:::
